title: On Emerging from the fog at the bend
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：emerge　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 emerge 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the planner ① emerged from the fog at the bend twice over, and every citizen in the district said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the planner ② emerges from the fog at the bend year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ emerge from the fog at the bend at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ emerged from the fog at the bend before — a line in the report for March 1977 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Emerging from the fog at the bend twice over, the planner said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the plan at the far square, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ emerge as the strongest of the four year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Emerge as the strongest of the four at once and never mention it again.

By 1990 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the report, and a new citizen from the next district ⑧ emerges as the strongest of the four twice over every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the square, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ emerged from the fog at the bend again when nobody else would.

⑩ To emerge from the fog at the bend, my mother said in 1995, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the district remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the district forgets, somebody emerges from the fog at the bend year after year again and somebody must emerge from the fog at the bend twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 出现（一般过去式 emerged from the fog at the bend：1983 年规划员头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 出现（一般现在 emerges from the fog at the bend：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 出现（不定式 to emerge from the fog at the bend：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 出现（过去完成时 had emerged from the fog at the bend：1977 年三月的规划报告上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 出现（动名词 emerging from the fog at the bend 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 露头（emerge as the strongest of the four：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去露头显出它是四者中最结实的）
G. v. 露头（emerge as the strongest of the four：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 出现（后段两处：新来的市民照例 emerges as the strongest of the four，而母亲又一次 emerged from the fog at the bend）

answers.why: emerge 意为“出现”，1983 年规划员来回两遍出现在河湾处从雾里出现，那是街区里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 emerged。
emerge 意为“出现”，自那以后规划员年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 emerges。
emerge 意为“出现”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯出现在河湾处从雾里出现”，此处为不定式 to emerge from the fog at the bend。
emerge 意为“出现”，规划报告里 三月 那行字说明早在 1990 年之前就有人出现过，故用过去完成时 had emerged。
emerge 意为“出现”，规划员说“出现在河湾处从雾里出现这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 emerging from the fog at the bend 作主语。
emerge 意为“露头”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去露头显出它是四者中最结实的”，should ever 之后用原形 emerge as the strongest of the four。
emerge 意为“露头”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻露头显出它是四者中最结实的（emerge as the strongest of the four at once），以后再也不要提起。
emerge 意为“出现”，新来的市民每个年份都照例露头显出它是四者中最结实的，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 emerges。
emerge 意为“出现”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍出现在河湾处从雾里出现，用一般过去式 emerged 叙述。
emerge 意为“出现”，结尾那句是母亲 1995 年的话：要出现在河湾处从雾里出现，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和街区记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1983 年，规划员来回两遍出现在河湾处从雾里出现；街区里每一个市民都说这是头一回。（emerged from the fog at the bend）
多年以后，规划员仍年年地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（emerges from the fog at the bend）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯出现在河湾处从雾里出现这件事本身。（to emerge from the fog at the bend）

规划员说过，来回两遍出现在河湾处从雾里出现这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（emerging from the fog at the bend 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻露头显出它是四者中最结实的，以后再也不要提起。（emerge as the strongest of the four，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 emerge 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1983 the planner emerged from the fog at the bend twice over, and nobody in the district forgot it.
Even now the planner emerges from the fog at the bend year after year whenever the district asks.
Emerging from the fog at the bend twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever emerge as the strongest of the four year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new citizen from the next district emerges as the strongest of the four twice over every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother emerged from the fog at the bend again, and the district remembered that half.
